text.en:
Traps —

(a) Kilong (Deep water fish trap made of stakes, poles or other supports with leaders so designed as to lead fish into an enclosure, and the length of such leaders exceeding 60 fathoms .................................. $8.00

(b) Lintau (Shallow water fish trap made of stakes, poles or other supports with leader or leaders so designed as to lead fish into an enclosure, and the length of such leader or leaders not exceeding 60 fathoms ................................................................ $4.00

(c) Bubu: Any other type of fish trap longer than 3 feet .......................... $0.40

(d) Kabat: Any fish trap made of leader or leaders leading into a trap net — less than 5 yards in length ................................................................ No Fee more than 5 yards in length ............................................................. $4.00

(e) Tugu per net ........................................................................................ $4.00

Nets —

(a) Anchau, Paguyut: Any seine net with pocket and any seine net without pocket not — exceeding 40 yards in length ........................................................... $1.00 more than 40 yards in length ........................................................... $4.00

(b) Tabeh, Pukat: Any seine net without pocket not — exceeding 40 yards in length ........................................................... $1.00 more than 40 yards in length ........................................................... $4.00

(c) Andang, Tambak, Panau: Any bottom set gill net. Per 200 yards mounted length or part thereof ........................................................ $4.00

(d) Rantau, Slambau: Drifting and lifting gill nets. Per 100 yards mounted length or part thereof ........................................................ $2.00 SCHEDULE — (continued)

(e) Lukong: Any ring net or purse seine. Per 100 yards mounted length or part thereof .................................................................................. $30.00

(f) Panau: Any scoop net ......................................................................... $2.00

(g) Rambat: Any cast net ......................................................................... $1.00

(h) Pukat Rimau: Any trawl net including otter, beam, floating or midwater trawl and any other net used for sea fishing and not specified above ................................................................................ $200.00
